visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera is positioned in a retail store, likely a Japanese pharmacy. A hand reaches out to a shelf filled with Bioré The Body soap bottles. The hand grabs a white bottle with a pink pump. The background shows various skincare products and price tags in a bright, well-lit indoor retail environment. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of the soap bottle being held. The label is white with purple-to-pink gradients and clear Japanese text. The back of the bottle is then shown, revealing dense instructional text, diagrams, and small graphics illustrating the product's features and cleansing technology. (3) Two hands are shown operating the pump of the soap bottle. A thick, white, creamy foam is dispensed onto the hand. The texture of the foam appears airy yet firm and dense. (4) The white foam is applied in a long strip down a person's wet forearm. The hand then spreads the foam evenly across the skin. The lighting is bright and neutral, now in a setting that looks like a tiled bathroom or shower area. (5) The forearm is held under a stream of clear water. The foam is rinsed away quickly and efficiently. After the water stops, the skin on the arm appears clean, smooth, and notably reflective or shiny under the light, indicating a hydrated finish. (6) The video concludes with a static graphic screen. A large QR code is centered within a black-bordered white box on a light pink background. Promotional text overlays appear at the bottom directing the viewer to a shopping list.
